assertions.source: Δtr_M(q) is symbolic-rational; Taylor coefficients extracted as exact rationals

description: Habiro Taylor expansion of the exact Q_β expression in h = q - q⁻¹ basis at q=1. Tests whether the Q_β c_k are uniquely determined Habiro Taylor coefficients of a substrate-canonical Q_β formula consuming Habiro-witness-cited tr_M polynomials. If yes, closes the c_k flip-flop saga the same way PR #1511 closed the α_EM saga.

delta_tr_M_taylor_at_q_eq_1.note: These are the substrate-exact Taylor coefficients of Δtr_M(q) at q=1, computed symbolically from the Habiro-witness-cited rational tr_M expressions. The Q_β c_k will inherit from these via the (yet-undefined) categorical formula Q_β = m_e × f(Δtr_M, q).
